watches.name: TITANE-WOLRD RECORD – SOLD OUT
watches.description: On June 26, 2026, in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt, Stéphane Tourreau, ZRC Brand Ambassador since 2015, set a new CMAS World Record with a Variable Weight dive to -145 metres . To celebrate this extraordinary sporting achievement, ZRC created a dedicated Grands Fonds 3000 timepiece, engineered as a tribute to this exceptional feat. The ZRC MN64 Titanium is a true extreme Toolwatch , created for those who constantly push beyond their limits. Developed to combine performance, innovation and endurance, it brings together Swiss watchmaking precision, uncompromising robustness and timeless design. Throughout the long months leading up to his world-record attempt, Stéphane tested the watch far beyond 120 metres, proving its absolute reliability under the most demanding conditions. Its Grade 5 titanium case delivers the perfect balance of lightness and strength. Limited to just 50 pieces, this exclusive edition incorporates ZRC’s latest innovations: the ECS® (Easy Clean System), the programmed deformation caseback, the CPS™ (Crown Protection System), and LUMICAST technology. Crafted using 3D-printed SLN-X1 solid luminous material, the raised hour markers ensure outstanding legibility in the darkness of the ocean’s greatest depths. Its gradient Caribbean blue dial is a final reminder that the greatest achievements are always matched by timeless elegance—the hallmark of ZRC’s watchmaking excellence.

watches.name: S2-RUBBER – NEW
watches.description: Every detail of this distinctly sporty chic dive watch shares the same attributes as the original model created in the early 1960s. It is more than a dive watch, with its bold and timeless design, this model holds all the cards to becoming an everyday companion for both men and women. Its sleek domed dial, Magnum-style hands, hour circle, and minimalist bezel endow it with a multi-faceted personality. The comfortable steel wristband of the GF3811121118 – S2 accentuates its elegant character by perfectly complementing the prominent lines of the iconic hexagonal steel case. As with all ZRC ® watches, for the ultimate in water resistance, its modern design incorporates the latest innovations in programmed deformation of material.

watches.name: TORCH LIMITED EDITION – NEW
watches.description: On November 8, 1942, Operation TORCH marked a strategic turning point in North Africa. In Casablanca, the fighting was of rare intensity. Several 1,500-ton French submarines attempted to resist the American forces commanded by George S. Patton. Le Tonnant managed to escape before being scuttled off the coast of Cádiz on November 15, 1942. On November 15, 2025, exactly 83 years after its disappearance, its wreck was officially located and identified by a team of professional divers and hydrographers commissioned by ZRC, in full respect of this site, which has become a place of remembrance. Limited to just 50 pieces , this exclusive creation pays tribute to the submariners of the French undersea fleet and to their legacy of discretion, mastery, and excellence in the deep. A timepiece of character, conceived as a true horological object of remembrance. Its double-layered guilloché brass dial is enhanced by a deep green-to-black gradient, evoking the hypnotic variations of the Atlantic Ocean off the Moroccan coast. This chromatic depth gives the dial a unique presence, both mysterious and refined. The bezel, fitted with a ceramic insert, reinforces its contemporary identity, while the bronze case, featuring a circular brushed finish inspired by the brand’s historical models, expresses a subtle balance between heritage and modern sophistication. Resolutely sport-chic in its most elevated expression, the watch is completed by a Tropic-style rubber strap, enhancing both its technical spirit and vintage-inspired character. The overall design reflects a demanding vision of Swiss watchmaking, where every detail contributes to an aesthetic of refined distinction. It is powered by the Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement in an elaborated version, renowned for its reliability, precision, and robustness, ensuring performance worthy of its exclusivity.

watches.description: For its 120 years ZRC launched the search of lost submarine Q157 PHENIX disappeared in the Bay of Cam Rahn in Vietnam on June 15th 1939 in order to shed light on an 85 years old mystery. On this occasion ZRC® offers a Limited Edition of 200 pcs of its Grands Fonds MN64 1000M. Advantageously highlighted in a specific packaging with the PHENIX mouth tap as well as a 1/750th to the identical of the submarine, this Limited Edition is the ultimate tribute to the 76 sailors disappeared during the sinking. Its sunray blue dial was developed to imitate the reflections of the water at sea as well as the sunrays penetrating the abyssal depths. Like all MN64 1000M, it is equipped with the ECS® system that ensures optimal rinsing after immersion in salt water and eliminates impurities and salt crystals lodged between the unidirectional rotating bezel with a ceramic insert and the case. Its hands are orchestrated by the new SELLITA SW300-1 automatic movement in its elaborated version. This 100% Swiss Made movement is accurate to +/- 5sec/day and has a power reserve of 56H.

collections.name: GRANDS FONDS WATCHES
collections.description: A true embodiment of the Grands Fonds® spirit, ZRC ® watches are rooted in a tradition of industrial expertise developed since the 1920s in the manufacture of watertight cases. Created in 1959 following a tender from the French Navy, the ZRC ® watch gave rise to the Grands Fonds S1, the first response to the operational requirements of military divers. It later evolved into the S2, featuring a crown positioned at 6 o’clock, tested from 1964 to 1966 by the G.E.R.S. ZRC served as an official supplier to the French Navy from 1966 to 1994. Since then, ZRC has continued to uphold this technical mastery in the most demanding environments, including for special forces. This legitimacy is reinforced by close partnerships with elite units such as GSPM, GIGN, BRI, GIH, mine clearance divers, and FOST, all of whom trust ZRC ® to support their missions. Whether styled as sport-chic or pure dive watches, these boldly designed timepieces bring a relaxed elegance to both men’s and women’s wrists. As robust as the models originally designed for the French Navy, their monobloc cases in 316L steel or grade 5 titanium showcase ZRC’s unique expertise in designing perfectly watertight structures. They now incorporate exclusive high-tech processes such as the worldwide patented ECS ® system , the Crown Protection System™ , and a programmed deformation caseback , the result of advanced research into material reaction under extreme pressure. Combined with meticulous attention at every stage of production, these technical choices give ZRC ® watches one of the highest levels of resistance and reliability on the market. Certified from 300 meters to 3,000 meters, they are tested under extreme conditions down to -5,000 meters for the titanium MN64 models. Beyond the iconic 6 o’clock crown, the dials and bezels preserve ZRC’s distinctive design codes, including the famous “lollipop” seconds hand and, depending on the version, Magnum or slim hands, a date display, and raised indexes on the dial.

collections.name: MN64™
collections.description: The MN64™ collection, a modern-day vision of the 1964-created Grands Fonds 300 ® , comprises versatile, stylistic, day-to-day practical dive watches. All the references feature a 41.5 mm-diameter 316L steel case proposed with a wide array of dials. To ensure wearer-comfort, each timepiece can be complemented by a metal bracelet or a rubber or NATO-type fabric strap. Their optimized wearer-friendliness means that using the 60-notched unidirectional rotating bezel is amazingly easy. Time data is read at a glance even in the poorest conditions of light thanks to the Super-Luminova ® paint applied to the dial components. And, just like all ZRC ® watches, these models center stage the brand’s latest technical innovations in their famous hexagonal mono-block case, waterproof to depths of 1000 meters and tested to 1,500 m. They also integrate the Crown Protection System™ that guarantees 100% functional waterproofness. If the crown is not perfectly screwed tightly, the watch bracelet or strap cannot be clasped. The presence of the Easy Clean System, ECS ® , prevents sea salt from crystallizing between the unidirectional bezel and the case. Rinsing under fresh water after a dive dilutes and removes crystals and any other impurities. And, just like all ZRC ® watches “designed by divers for divers”, the watches of the “French Navy” 1964 reissue collection are driven by a highly-reliable automatic caliber, the Sellita SW-200 or the Sellita SW-300-1 in its sophisticated version.

collections.name: HERITAGE™
collections.description: A true expression of the spirit of the Grands Fonds ® , the references of the Grands Fonds HERITAGE™ line recapture the look of the diving watches created in the 1960s. All are designed to match the aesthetics of the original models as closely as possible and in every detail. Worn in a sporty chic or pure diver’s style, these boldly designed timepieces will grace both men’s and women’s wrists with casual elegance. Indeed, just as sturdy as the watches made for the French Navy, their one-piece case in 316L steel features a brand new diameter measuring 39mm. Their construction profits from the research carried out on the programmed deformation of material to withstand the enormous pressures encountered under the seas and oceans. Indeed, as with all ZRC ® watches, these incorporate the latest technical innovations ensuring proven water resistance to a depth of 300 meters after a battery of tests at a depth of 1,000 meters. Along with the iconic crown at 6 o’clock, the dials and bezels are in keeping with the ZRC ® style including the famous “lollipop” second hand. Depending on the variation, the watch comes with a choice of Magnum-type hour and minute hands, a date, and a precise graduated scale. The dial components are finished with a high-intensity Super-LumiNova X1 coating to ensure optimal legibility. As with all ZRC ® watches “designed by divers for divers”, the Grands Fonds HERITAGE™ references are powered by a highly reliable self-winding caliber, the Sellita SW-200 in its advanced version.

collections.name: SECURICODE WATCHES
collections.description: A tribute to the very first Grands Fonds watch from 1959, the ZRC SECURICODE embodies the origin of a horological legend born from a tender issued by the French Navy. A true founding piece, it laid the very first foundations of a unique expertise from the outset. Tested by the G.R.S. of the French Navy between May and November 1961, and subsequently officially adopted, this first version of the Grands Fonds — still featuring a crown positioned at 3 o’clock — equipped French Navy divers until 1966. An authentic heritage from which the Securicode draws inspiration with both precision and modernity. More refined than its descendant dedicated to extreme diving, the Securicode stands out for its timeless elegance. It reinterprets the original design codes in a perfectly controlled neo-vintage spirit, conceived for an urban chic lifestyle. Its balanced design, both understated and assertive, makes it a timepiece equally at home under a shirt cuff or in the most demanding everyday environments. The case, the result of ZRC’s long-standing expertise in designing perfectly watertight structures, stands out for the quality of its finishing, precisely alternating satin-brushed and polished surfaces. The integration of noble materials, such as a ceramic bezel insert, further enhances both the durability and refinement of the whole. It also incorporates the brand’s latest innovations, including the programmed deformation caseback , an exclusive technology resulting from extensive research into material behaviour under high pressure. Every detail is given the utmost attention, reflecting a high level of manufacturing excellence and a sense of detail characteristic of Swiss watchmaking. True to the ZRC® philosophy, the Securicode is powered by a Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement in an elaborated version, renowned for its reliability, precision, and robustness. collections.name: GF 300
collections.description: All the Grands Fonds 300 ® dive watches in the 1964 Spirit collection, which share the same DNA, perpetuate the spirit of the first-ever Grands Fonds ® created back in 1964. For two decades, this sturdy, accurate timepiece met the requirements of specifications imposed by the French National Navy for equipping its clearance divers. In this collection, the timepieces, showcasing a 41.5 mm-diameter case, waterproof to depths of 300 m, and all tested down to 1,500 m, combine vintage stylistic details with state-of-the-art engineering design. The Magnum-type hands, the indexes and the “lollipop”-styled direct-drive are coated with beige Super-LumiNova ® . Moreover, all the models embrace ZRC ® ’s latest technical innovations. The Easy Clean System, ECS ® , prevents sea salt from crystallizing between the unidirectional bezel and the 316L steel case. Thanks to this device, cleaning the watch with fresh water after a dive ensures salt crystals and impurities are removed. The Crown Protection System™ guarantees 100% waterproofness. The bracelet or strap cannot be clasped if the crown is not totally screwed. These versatile watches also offer optimized wearer-friendliness for secure use when diving. As such, the unidirectional rotating bezel is slightly withdrawn to ensure its set marker doesn’t change unintentionally during underwater excursions. To forever be in tune with stylistic preferences of the times, ZRC ® proposes a variety of dials, with or without minute tracker and date. Whatever model you choose, the Grands Fonds 300 ® 1964 Spirit watch hosts an automatic Sellita SW-200-1 caliber in its sophisticated version, renowned for its reliability. Each watch can be coordinated with a metal bracelet, a leather or a NATO strap.
